I'll search the codebase for how repository validity and fingerprints are computed.
The key file is `src/view/validity.rs`. Let me read it and the fingerprint module.
Let me check how the stored snapshot/index validity is actually checked at reuse time — the `FingerprintMismatch` path and where `validate` is invoked.

ANSWER:
Repository (view) validity is computed as a `validity_key` — a SHA-256 digest over the serialized `ValidityInputs` record, which bundles every input that materially affects the reusable derived index: the schema tag, `content_fingerprint`, `analyzer_fingerprint`, `snapshot_config_digest`, and the `link`/`candidate`/`graph` producer-policy fingerprints (`src/view/validity.rs:26-42`, `key()` at 97-99). `ensure_index` recomputes the view manifest, builds `ValidityInputs::current`, keys the index directory as `indexes/{key[7..23]}`, and on a hit reads the stored `validity.json` and field-compares it via `ValidityInputs::validate` — any mismatch yields a bounded `InvalidReason` (source/metadata/analyzer/config/link/candidate/graph changed) and forces rebuild (`src/view/index.rs:245-294`, `src/view/validity.rs:120-142`).

The fingerprint source for repository content is `ViewManifest::fingerprint()` (`src/view/manifest.rs:66-81`): a SHA-256 (`digest::content_digest`) over the canonical `file path=… lang=… content=…` lines for every source file plus `meta path=… content=…` lines for the consulted metadata inputs (`go.mod`, `Cargo.toml`, `METADATA_FILES` at line 59). The per-file digests are SHA-256 of source bytes (`src/repository/digest.rs:24-38`); `(mtime_ns, change_ns, size)` is only a skip-rehash hint, never the identity authority (`src/view/manifest.rs:84-118`). Producer identity comes from `AnalyzerFingerprint::current(registry)` — SHA-256 of `schema={SCHEMA_VERSION} abi={ANALYSIS_ABI_VERSION} ts_language_version/ts_min_compatible` plus each language's grammar `crate_name:crate_version` (`src/repository/fingerprint.rs:79-98`) — alongside `LinkFingerprint`, `CandidateFingerprint`, and `GraphFingerprint`. At the snapshot level, reuse validity is the same fingerprint source compared via `manifest.fingerprint_matches(fingerprint) && manifest.config_matches(config)` (`src/repository/build.rs:181-211`).
